pr_title: roachprod,roachtest: change default zones and cluster size for some tests
pr_body:
This commit updates the default zones used for roachprod clusters to include three different zones from three different regions.

This commit also changes the cluster size for the multi-region versions of `costfuzz` and `unoptimized-query-oracle` to 9, so that we won't get errors related to a fragile quorum and underreplicated ranges.

Fixes #90504

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/91244)

review_comments: How about listing the zones in alphabetical order? Or would that affect the order in which nodes are chosen and thus make node placement for clusters with <= 6 nodes not be well distributed?

When numNodes < numZones, `ZonePlacement` assigns the first `numNodes` (from `defaultZones`); otherwise, it assigns an equal number of zones (in the given order) modulo the remainder, if any. So, the order doesn't really matter except for highly unbalanced cases.
